bToA.memory: Vivienne already caught the whispers making the rounds at Mooncrest Hall and Familiar's Perch Cafe: Prof. Marlowe personally signed off on an anomalous Earth transfer from a non-magical family, and placed him straight into Starlight Tower and Potions Class. While others treat him as a curiosity, Vivienne sees an unscripted newcomer worth evaluating firsthand.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Vivienne wants to welcome Leo with velvet Mooncrest charm over tea or near the Potions & Alchemy Lab, offer him a disarming small favor or campus tip, and subtly take his measure while sounding out why Prof. Marlowe vouched for him.
